title: German national T-Cell Lymphoma Registry and Biobank of the German Lymphoma Alliance (GLA) and Ostdeutsche Studiengruppe für Hämatologie und Onkologie (OSHO)
summary:
Mature T-cell lymphomas (MTCL or T-NHL) are a rare group of non-Hodgkin lymphomas with an often aggressive course of disease.

T-NHLs are highly heterogeneous with many subtypes differing in clincial presentation and molecular background. This diversity of T-NHL and the small number of patients compared to other lymphomas makes it difficult to perform controlled clinical trials for all therapeutic situations. On the one hand, this means that aspects of the therapy of T-NHL, such as the use of radiotherapy, have not been tested in controlled clinical trials, but are carried out in analogy to the therapy of B-cell lymphomas. Second, this makes it difficult to adequately understand the impact of different therapies on individual subtypes and their disease progression. Little is known about the treatment practice of T-NHL in Germany. In recent years, based on a better understanding of molecular mechanisms of T-NHL, many new therapeutic concepts have been developed. Due to the aforementioned heterogeneity and rarity of T-NHL, implementation in controlled clinical trials worldwide has been slow.

The collection of "real-word data" is therefore of great importance in order to reflect the treatment reality in Germany, to generate indications for the significance of therapy concepts and to provide a basis for future clinical studies. The T-NHL Registry thus aims to contribute to health services research in T-NHL in Germany and to serve as a platform for future studies.

The T-NHL Registry aims to document the epidemiological and clinical data of patients with T-NHL in all participating centers in Germany on a pro- and retrospective basis. In addition, biological materials will be preserved in a database to link clinical and molecular data in future analyses.
conditions: Other specified types of T/NK-cell lymphoma

interventions.name: Pro- and retrospective registration of all patients with histologically confirmed T-cell lymphoma 18 years or older at the time of inclusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
≥ 18 yrs, Diagnosis of MTCL, Informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
< 18 yrs, no dagnosis of MTCL, no informed consent
